MiscellaneousBase.description: MiscellaneousBase provides unique properties to identify individual records of ingredients that are neither hops, nor provide a contribution to the gravity of wort.

producer.description: The company that produced the ingredient.

product_id.description: The producer's catalogue number for the ingredient.

type.description: The kind of ingredient, which indicates what it is used for.

MiscellaneousType.description: MiscellaneousType collects the attributes of an ingredient to store as record information.

use_for.description: Used to describe the purpose of the miscellaneous ingredient, e.g. whirlfloc is used for clarity.

notes.description: Free text notes about the ingredient.

MiscellaneousAdditionType.description: MiscellaneousAdditionType collects the attributes of each miscellaneous ingredient for use in a recipe.

timing.description: The timing object fully describes the timing of an addition with options for basis on time, gravity, or pH at any process step.

amount.description: The quantity added: by mass, by volume, or by unit for a countable item such as a tablet.

MiscellaneousInventoryType.description: The quantity of a miscellaneous ingredient held in stock.

amount.description: The quantity held in stock: by mass, by volume, or by unit for a countable item.
